name: Kadokura Monzan
source:
A Buddhist priest, who seems to like the company of women. He is very strong and knows many things and even has medical knowledge to the extent that he can stitch a wound back together perfectly. He gives himself the nickname "Mon-Mon", and tries to sound cute. This usually means he isn't taken seriously.
He says Yo is like his little brother and treats him that way.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yo-Jin-Bo#Characters]Wikipedia]
